description: This script manages the review lifecycle for components by updating metadata YAML files related to review dates. It provides commands to start, stop, or clear review cycles across multiple components within the repository.

methods.name: list_components
methods.description: Lists all components by finding metadata.yaml files and processing their paths.

methods.name: show_help
methods.description: Displays help information about using the script.

methods.name: resolve_metadata
methods.description: Resolves and validates the path to a component's metadata YAML file.

methods.name: add_business_days
methods.description: Calculates a date by adding a specified number of business days to a given date.

methods.name: clear_dates
methods.description: Removes review lifecycle date entries from a metadata YAML file.

methods.name: regen_report
methods.description: Regenerates the RAG status report by calling an external script.
